rules.desc: Covered/underground reservoirs rendered as tall blocks
rules.match: OSM man_made=reservoir_covered or building with layer<0 / name 'Rezervor subteran' (pipeline: Overture building with no height/levels)
rules.change: h=1.5 (or skip). 9 cases in Ciocana, 13-31 m now.

rules.desc: Untagged industrial halls get random 16/19/28/31 m
rules.match: building without height/num_floors, A>=400, OSM building in (industrial,warehouse) or centroid in landuse=industrial/garages; current h in {16,19,28,31}
rules.change: h=9 if A<1500 else 11 (single-storey halls). 391 buildings in Ciocana (262 at >=19 m). Verified on the Uzinelor zone (3450,1350): halls of 28-31 m with no visible long shadows.

rules.desc: Private houses rendered as 3-4 storey blocks
rules.match: building without height/num_floors, 120<=A<400, OSM building=yes or untagged, >=8 buildings <300 m2 within 60 m (private-house area); current h in {10,13}
rules.change: h=rand([5,6.5,7]). 386 buildings in Ciocana. Verified NE of Uzinelor (4479,2563): pitched-roof 1-2 storey houses at 10/13 m.

rules.desc: Multi-section blocks get a different random height per section
rules.match: adjacent untagged building parts (shared wall, same orientation)
rules.change: give every section one height (from a tagged neighbour if present, else max). Example: 4704..4770,-2568.

rules.desc: Two-way roads with OSM lanes>=5 drawn too narrow
rules.match: kind 0, ow 0, OSM lanes>=5 (pipeline ignores OSM lanes outside the centre extract)
rules.change: w = lanes*3.3+0.6. Verified on Alecu Russo (6 lanes, ~19 m). Also Lunca Bacului (OSM lanes=6, data 14), not satellite-checked. Do NOT apply OSM lanes blindly: lanes=2 on Mesterul Manole and lanes=1 on Sadoveanu are wrong (3 and 2+2 visible).

rules.desc: Floor height of tagged Soviet blocks
rules.match: buildings with num_floors and no height (pipeline h = 3.2*lv+0.6/1.2)
rules.change: optional global: h = 2.8*lv+1.8 (5->15.8, 9->27, 16->46.6) to match typical panel blocks; current 17.2/29.4/51.8 are ~8-12% tall. Not shadow-verified.
